artworks.title: Edge of the Water (Au bord de l'eau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a dense woodland scene with a perspective from a slightly elevated view. The clearing between the trees is visible, surrounded by vertical tree trunks and lush foliage. The detailed etching style features fine lines and soft shading to depict textures of the trees and leaves. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brown and gray. A small tree with leaves is in the foreground, while taller trees are visible in the distance, creating a sense of depth. The background gradually fades into lighter tones, emphasizing the center of the composition.

artworks.title: Near the Woods, Veronne (Pres du bois, Veronne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a nature scene from a slightly elevated perspective, showing a dense forest area with no visible horizon line. The forest is filled with large, mature trees with textured bark and abundant foliage, creating an enclosed and deep space. The art style features detailed line work capturing the shapes of leaves and branches. The color palette is black and white, giving a classic appearance to the scene. Intricate linear patterns and crosshatching add texture and depth to the landscape, with more trees and shrubs visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Hurricane (L'ouragan)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heavily wooded landscape. The drawing depicts several tall, gnarled trees with large twisting trunks and branches dominating the scene. The forest appears dense with detailed bark and foliage. The landscape conveys age and mystery, characterized by lines and shading that create depth and texture. The ground is uneven and covered with underbrush. The sky in the background is filled with swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Small Boat in Peril (Barque en peril)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures positioned along the left edge, with the viewpoint situated slightly behind and above them. The background features swirling lines representing waves and sky, with a barely discernible horizon. The finely detailed brushstrokes create texture and movement, especially in the water and clothing. The monochromatic palette of varying shades of gray intensifies the scene's drama, contrasting the figures with the turbulent environment. A solitary figure in the distance struggles in the waves, conveying a feeling of openness and vulnerability against the vast sea.

artworks.title: Little Shelter (Le petit hangar)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a thatched-roof structure surrounded by trees. A person is visible on a dirt path leading to the structure. In the distance, there is a village with faint suggestions of buildings and a church. The scene is rendered in detailed, intricate line work typical of etching, with a monochrome color palette of sepia and black.

artworks.title: Banks of the Somme near Amiens (Bord de la Somme pres d'Amiens)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with a small body of water and a figure boating. The scene includes trees, a horizon line, and a monochromatic color palette of earthy tones. The artwork is executed with fine-lined etching techniques, creating intricate textures. A figure is seen boating on the water while trees frame the composition.

artworks.title: Footbridge (La passerelle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a footbridge over a stream, vegetation, a figure on a rock, thatched roofs, and a conical-roofed structure in the distance. The setting includes rolling hills and trees, depicted in sepia tones with detailed textures and fine brushstrokes emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Rest along the Banks of the River (Repos au bord de la riviere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from within a grove of trees, looking towards a riverbank. In the foreground, there are tall trees framing the scene, leading the eye towards two figures near the river. The horizon is created by the river's edge and distant trees, adding depth to the composition. The style resembles delicate etching, with fine lines detailing the foliage and figures. The monochromatic color palette in soft sepia tones creates a tranquil atmosphere. In the distance, the river flows gently through the landscape, surrounded by lush vegetation, capturing a moment of calm nature.

artworks.title: Hamlet near the Lake (Le hameau pres du lac)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a high horizon line. The artwork features delicate and finely detailed brushstrokes or etching lines showing trees, foliage, and a building in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia or earthy tones. In the foreground, a figure can be seen working with a tool, obscured by grass and bushes. The landscape is filled with trees of different sizes, leading towards a distant horizon with a structure nestled among them. The sky is lightly etched in the background, creating a sense of open space.

artworks.title: Man Foraging (L'homme au fourrage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man working in a forest. He is wearing a hat, a shirt, and a vest. The scene is detailed, with various trees and foliage surrounding the man. The landscape extends into the distance, with the horizon marked by a line of trees. The artwork uses fine etching techniques with different line weights to create texture. The color scheme is sepia-toned. The overall impression is one of a harmonious moment in a lush setting.

artworks.title: Young Peasant Seated in a Church (Jeune paysanne assise dans une eglise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with their upper body visible. The individual is slightly turned to the left, with their head bowed and eyes closed or lowered. Their face has soft features, and they are wearing a hood or fabric covering their head and neck. The person is dressed in loose, flowing fabric with many folds. Their hand rests on their lap, and a book is beside them. The background has a cross-hatched texture, suggesting a wall and possibly a window or panel section behind them.

artworks.title: Gust of Wind (Un coup de vent)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with two figures, a leaning tree, and a rustic dwelling. The view is slightly elevated, providing a look down onto the scene. The horizon is high, with distant hills and a small house visible. The etching features fine and intricate lines depicting textures in the trees and figures' clothing. The color palette is monochromatic with soft grays and beige, creating a serene atmosphere. Two figures walk along a curved path, with one leaning on a stick and the other carrying something on their back. Trees on the left bend in the wind, while a small house is seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Girl (Tete de jeune fille)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the head up. The person is facing forward with a neutral expression. The facial features are detailed, with a well-defined structure and evenly spaced eyes. The hair is neatly styled and pulled back. They are wearing a high-collared blouse with visible pleats on the front. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is plain and beige, with light shading. The artist's signature and the year '1904' are inscribed in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Death: Death Prepares a Dwelling for the Homeless (Le triomphe de la Mort: Lamort a prepare une demeure a des abandonnees)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals. Three are standing and one is reclining. The standing individuals are detailed from head to toe, with one using a walking stick for support. The seated figure is reclined against a tree trunk, and all individuals have intense facial expressions. They wear headscarves and long garments resembling robes. The reclining figure appears skeletal. They are surrounded by dense foliage and bare trees in a rural landscape. The background is minimal, emphasizing the figures and foliage. The image is in black and white.

artworks.title: Spring (Le printemps)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral view from an elevated angle, showing a group of figures relaxing on a grassy hillside. A woman sits with her back turned, accompanied by a cherubic figure. A man reclines nearby, while to the right, a woman and a child interact. Trees populate the horizon, suggesting rolling hills stretching beyond. The artwork features detailed etching techniques with a monochromatic sepia color palette. Other figures can be seen in the background, adding to the scene's continuity.

artworks.title: Summer (L'ete)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint? in dark brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered outdoors. Various adults and children are positioned in seated and standing poses. The adults and children have different facial features, with some adults having distinct features and various hairstyles. They are wearing historical rural attire. The children have curly hair and appear curious, with one child playing in water. The scene is surrounded by trees and foliage in a wooded setting. The background includes detailed sketches of trees and bushes. The etching style adds depth and texture to the image.

artworks.title: Man Climbing a Wall (L'escalade)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features an individual leaning forward with their hands on a ledge, facing slightly to the side. They have a beard, mustache, deep-set eyes, and pronounced cheekbones. The person wears a cap and loose-fitting clothing. The background shows closely packed tree trunks, creating a wooded area. The image has a sketched appearance with fine lines for texture.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, Medallion, No.1, 9th plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed pencil drawing of a man's head and shoulders facing left in profile. The man has a prominent nose and deep-set eye, a large forehead with receding, wavy gray hair extending to the back, and a flowing beard merging with his hair. He wears a garment, likely a robe, with soft folds covering his shoulders. The background features a shaded circular area with faint text that reads: "SCULPTOR 1885."

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, Medallion, No.2, 11th plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a side profile of an older man's head and upper shoulder in a circular composition. The man faces right and has a prominent nose, full beard, and voluminous hair. He wears a robe or coat that covers his shoulders. The background is indistinct, with text inscribed along the left and right curvature: "LEGROS" on the left, and "PICTOR 1905" on the right.

artworks.title: E.R. Hughes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image includes a pencil-drawn, profile-only depiction of a person's face on a coin or medallion. The individual is shown in a left-profile view with short hair and a neatly groomed moustache. The facial expression is calm with features suggesting a mature man. The person is wearing a high-collared shirt or coat. Surrounding the medallion are inscriptions of the person's name and a possible title or profession. Below this larger medallion is a smaller circular design with text reading "THE EYE TO SEE, THE HEART TO FEEL, THE HAND TO FOLLOW." The background of the image is plain and consists of a shaded pencil-like texture surrounding the medallions.

artworks.title: Little Pond (La petite mare)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a dense woodland area from a slightly elevated perspective. A wide tree is depicted in the left corner with detailed etchings of its bark and branches. Tall, slender trees fill the composition, reaching up towards the sky. The horizon is not visible, and the tops of foliage and trees imply the landscape's vastness. The artwork features delicate, controlled etched lines to showcase texture and shading of the trees and undergrowth. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of brown from the etching process. In the background, the foliage continues, creating a dense, organic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, 12th plate
artworks.medium: etching? and drypoint retouched with crayon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a profile sketch of a man's upper body and head. The man is positioned in profile, facing to the left. He has distinct facial features including a prominent nose and deep-set eyes, along with long hair flowing back from a receding hairline. The man also sports a full, textured beard. He appears to be wearing a garment, possibly a robe or cloak, which is loosely draped over his shoulders, with minimal detailing. No jewelry or additional objects are depicted. The background is plain, with light crosshatching.

artworks.title: At the Home of the Woodcutters (Chez les bucherons)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a felled tree trunk with axes and a straw hat nearby. A figure is bending down near thatched-roof buildings. Hills are visible in the distance, creating depth. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes, emphasizing textures in the trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black.

artworks.title: Remembrance of the Lake at Trastimene (Souvenir du lac de Trastimene)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. Tall trees frame the view on either side. Two figures are seen in the foreground, one bending forward and the other sitting to the right. The background shows rolling hills, open fields, and expressive cloud formations in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and sepia.
